notes.title: The release date has been decided.
notes.content:
This work will be released on December 1, 2023.
I'm so excited to finally be able to release it.
I put all my effort into making it, so I hope you enjoy it.
If you have any questions, please reply.

notes.title: Regarding the abolition of virus creation function
notes.content:
Due to various circumstances, we would like to inform you that we will be discontinuing the virus creation function.
We apologize to those who were looking forward to the virus creation function.
Also, this is only at the time of release, and if possible, we would like to include a virus creation function in a future update.
